description: Session command logs are plain text. Observed live 2026-11-04: GET /process/session/{sessionId}/command/{commandId}/logs (and /process/session/entrypoint/logs) answer `text/plain` with the command's combined stdout and stderr, whatever the Accept header, not the JSON { output, stdout, stderr } the spec declares; decoding the declared shape yields undefined fields.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: The command's combined stdout and stderr, as text.
